description: Workspace skeleton and tooling: root Cargo.toml with exact-pinned [workspace.dependencies] (design.md §3) and lints/profile (§4), rust-toolchain.toml, .cargo/config.toml, .gitattributes, .gitignore (+.DS_Store), all eight packages as buildable stubs (OS crates cfg-gated, agent lib+bin), tools/keymap-gen (fetch.sh run once, generator + --check), the checked-in keymap table with core Hid type and keymap API + tests, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and deny.toml. Plan items 1-6 in /Users/kulacidmyt/Documents/macwin/.agents/tasks/phase0a-plan.md (section C) with decisions B1 and B8. First feature; everything else depends on it.
steps: Plan item 1: create /Users/kulacidmyt/Documents/macwin/Cargo.toml (members crates/* + tools/keymap-gen, resolver 3, [workspace.package] version 0.1.0 / edition 2024 / rust-version 1.96 / publish false, no license; [workspace.lints.rust] unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn=deny, unused_must_use=deny; [workspace.lints.clippy] undocumented_unsafe_blocks=warn; [profile.release] lto=thin, debug=line-tables-only; [workspace.dependencies] = every row of design.md §3 with =pins, default-features=false and feature lists exactly as given, plus path deps for the 6 internal library crates). Create rust-toolchain.toml and .cargo/config.toml verbatim from design §4, .gitattributes `* text=auto eol=lf`, append `.DS_Store` to .gitignore.

Plan item 1 (cont.): create crates/macwin-core, macwin-proto, macwin-net, macwin-platform (with `[features] testing = []`), macwin-platform-macos (`[features] private-cursor-api = []`, objc2*/libc under [target.'cfg(target_os = "macos")'.dependencies]), macwin-platform-windows (windows-sys with the §3 feature list under [target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]), macwin-agent ([lib] name macwin_agent path src/lib.rs, [[bin]] name macwin path src/main.rs, features default=["private-cursor-api"], private-cursor-api=["macwin-platform-macos/private-cursor-api"], target-specific deps on the OS crates, dev-deps macwin-platform{features=["testing"]} + tempfile), tools/keymap-gen (package keymap-gen, anyhow only). Every crate `[lints] workspace = true`. Stub sources: `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` + crate doc in core/proto/net/platform/agent lib.rs; `#![cfg(target_os = "macos")]` / `#![cfg(windows)]` + doc in the OS crates; `fn main() {}` placeholders for the agent bin and keymap-gen.

Plan item 2: write tools/keymap-gen/fetch.sh (set -euo pipefail; curl -fsSL the Chromium dom_code_data.inc and LICENSE `?format=TEXT` URLs | base64 -D into tools/keymap-gen/data/dom_code_data.inc and data/LICENSE.chromium; write data/SOURCE.txt with URLs, UTC date and shasum -a 256 of both), chmod +x, run it exactly once.

Plan item 3: implement keymap-gen in tools/keymap-gen/src/main.rs (split into parse.rs/emit.rs if large) per design §5.4: comment stripping per line (tolerate \r), multi-line DOM_CODE( entries, 7 top-level args, hex parse, NULL or string code; keep page 0x07 usage >= 0x04 and page 0x0C with at least one native code (win != 0 or mac != 0xFFFF); fail on < 200 parsed entries, malformed fields, duplicate hid/win/mac; deterministic output with the exact @generated header and Chromium provenance line; KEYS sorted by hid, MAC_TO_HID [u32;128], WIN_TO_HID [u32;512] indexed (sc & 0xFF) | 0x100 if extended; `--check` compares in memory and exits 1 with `generated keymap is stale; run `cargo run -p keymap-gen``. Unit tests on an inline fixture (multi-line entry, `//DOM_CODE(` commented entry, NULL code, page-0x01 entry excluded, duplicate -> error, emitter determinism).

Plan item 4: run `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable cargo run -p keymap-gen` to write crates/macwin-core/src/keymap/generated.rs. Add crates/macwin-core/src/types.rs with the complete Hid type from design §5.1 (consts ESCAPE, LEFT_CTRL..RIGHT_GUI and the other modifier consts, page(), usage(), modifier_bit(), derives Debug Clone Copy PartialEq Eq PartialOrd Ord Hash) and crates/macwin-core/src/keymap/mod.rs (`#[rustfmt::skip] mod generated;`, pub fns hid_to_mac, mac_to_hid, hid_to_win, win_to_hid(scan, extended), name). Tests: sorted/unique, both round trips for all mapped entries, design §5.4 spot checks, letters A-Z, digits, 8 modifiers, arrows, F1-F12, IntlBackslash (mac 0x0A), E0-extended Windows keys (RightCtrl 0xE01D, RightAlt 0xE038, arrows, Insert/Delete/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown, NumpadDivide 0xE035, NumpadEnter 0xE01C, MetaLeft 0xE05B/MetaRight, PrintScreen 0xE037, NumLock 0xE045 vs Pause 0x0045).

Plan item 5: write /Users/kulacidmyt/Documents/macwin/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES (Chromium section: derived file, source URL, verbatim text of data/LICENSE.chromium; note that Rust crate deps carry their own licenses enforced by deny.toml).

Plan item 6: write /Users/kulacidmyt/Documents/macwin/deny.toml exactly per plan B8, then run the cargo-metadata license audit (python3 script over `cargo metadata --format-version 1 --all-features`, evaluating AND/OR/'/'/WITH against the allow-list) and confirm no offending package; never allow GPL/AGPL/LGPL.

findings: DATA: tools/keymap-gen/fetch.sh ran exactly once (2026-10-12T17:52:28Z). dom_code_data.inc sha256 841e2c58e6388f14736717eb6e365c8b8e9767788e36339bf1d35a37ab48e5b2 (identical to design §2). LICENSE.chromium sha256 368cca1106be99d39ecd32a38d8305585d802a475effb66380b91ffc9bcf709b (BSD-3-Clause, 'Copyright 2015 The Chromium Authors'; the upstream file itself has '// ' line prefixes and is copied verbatim). The LICENSE was fetched from the same chromium.googlesource.com host in the same script: flag in the final report. Both URLs, date and hashes are in data/SOURCE.txt. KEYMAP: 246 DOM_CODE entries parsed (matches design); KEYS has 153 entries (137 page 0x07 + 16 page 0x0C); MAC_TO_HID has 119 non-zero slots, WIN_TO_HID 153. generated.rs is 819 lines, sha256 7b69e45fa06940cabcd699fe5a3615dda117f39ac61d264e00f76d403a609d9b. Data quirks handled: mixed-case hex (0x0c019C), multi-line entries, multi-line commented-out entries. keymap-gen = src/{main.rs,parse.rs,emit.rs} with 17 unit tests; `--check` exits 1 with exactly 'generated keymap is stale; run `cargo run -p keymap-gen`' (a missing file counts as stale); write mode leaves the file untouched when it is up to date; other errors print 'keymap-gen: error: ...' and exit 1. CORE API (for FEAT-002+): lib.rs declares only `pub mod keymap; pub mod types;` (no re-exports yet); types.rs holds only Hid (ESCAPE, LEFT_CTRL, LEFT_SHIFT, LEFT_ALT, LEFT_GUI, RIGHT_CTRL, RIGHT_SHIFT, RIGHT_ALT, RIGHT_GUI; const fn page/usage/modifier_bit; derives Debug Clone Copy PartialEq Eq PartialOrd Ord Hash) + 2 tests. keymap: hid_to_mac, mac_to_hid, hid_to_win (0xE0xx for extended), win_to_hid(scan, extended), name; 11 keymap tests. DECISION: win_to_hid returns None for scan > 0xFF instead of masking with & 0xFF, so out-of-range codes never alias onto real keys (the 0x21D fake LCtrl before AltGr maps to None); os::windows::scan_to_hid can rely on this. REVIEWER FLAG: Keyboard Power (0x070066, win 0xE05E, no mac code) is kept by the design's filter rule (page 0x07 with a native code). It can never reach a Mac because it has no mac code, but it differs from design's wording that system-power keys are never forwarded (that wording refers to pages 0x00/0x01). PINS: all 21 design §3 rows are exact-pinned with features and default-features exactly as listed (checked by script against design.md and Cargo.lock); no pin or feature adjustments were needed. Cargo.lock is created; aws-lc-rs is absent (cargo tree -i fails with 'did not match any packages').
